text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tokyo Daishoten has 
arrived. Oi Racecourse was buzzing with 
more excitement than usual!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon really does catch your eye 
after all, doesn't she~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right? It's my first time watching dirt, 
so I wonder how she runs? She was super 
cute during the live concert, though!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Falco-chan! Do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I'm cheering for you~! Can't wait for the 
live performance!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so much☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I'll chase you to the ends of 
reincarnation itself☆ Smart Falcon is 
gonna do her best♪"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With all this excitement before the race, 
you'd think she'd be thrilled, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon herself seems somewhat 
lacking in focus. Even her usual 
catchphrase lacked its typical sharp 
energy.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Um, nope! Nothing's really... on my mind, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Still... ...Can more people really fit 
in?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's still early... I wonder if more 
spectators will show up once the race gets 
closer.
choice_data_list:
Even now, there's more in there than in 
usual years.

Even now, there's more in there than in 
usual years.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The attention on Smart Falcon translates 
directly into attention for the dirt 
division. In other words—
choice_data_list: Your hard work is bearing fruit.
Your hard work is really paying off!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Aha, I'd be so happy if that were true☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because... we did everything we could, 
right? To the point where we couldn't have 
done anything more—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as race time drew near, Smart Falcon 
remained restless and on edge.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, Trainer-san. I wonder what the 
attendance numbers are at right now?”
choice_data_list: They say over 30,000 people for sure.

Apparently they're expecting over 30,000 
people for sure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Smart Falcon had been curious about 
it, I checked with the staff, and added 
that they were thrilled to share the 
answer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
30,000 people... That's amazing. ...By the 
way, what about the recent Arima Kinen?
choice_data_list: I think it was around 110,000 people.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Te...!? A-Amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I see. There's still... such a 
huge gap between us.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"The Tokyo Daishoten is the year's final 
grand showdown. It draws far more 
attention than a typical dirt race..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So many of the fans who supported Falco 
this year have come out to watch, too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And yet... it hasn't reached them, has it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having experienced the massive excitement 
of the Arima Kinen, she seems to feel the 
current buzz falls somewhat short. But...
choice_data_list: Let's not worry about it anymore.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list:
This isn't a stage you can win without 
total focus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Senior, junior, it doesn't matter—the 
Tokyo Daishoten gathers only the truly 
skilled Umamusume. If you don't focus 
entirely on winning, you won't win."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Right, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! Maybe Falco was rushing things a 
bit too much.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I did everything I possibly could, after 
all. It's too late to change the outcome 
now.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then let's just forget about that for now 
and aim straight for center stage!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—I'm fine now! Falco's eyes are locked 
straight onto center stage!
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's make it the best year-end 
ever!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Yes!
